event_name: MOPAR NHRA Las Vegas Nationals powered by Dodge

pairs.note:
Matt Hartford's 29 round wins are the 2nd most for him in any year (31 - 2023). Hartford's overall
record at this event is 10-13, with a round-by-round record of 6-7 in Round 1, 3-3 in Round 2, 1-2 in
Round 3, and 0-1 in the final. He was runner-up here in 2025, losing to Dallas Glenn. He has
qualified in the top half of the field at six of his 16 races here. His lowest starting position was
15th, in 2015, and he has three DNQs at this event. He is 9-4 in the Countdown this year.

 Kenny Delco is 1 - 6 against Hartford in Rd. 1.  Delco's overall record at this event is 2-7, with a
round-by-round record of 2-5 in Round 1, 0-2 in Round 2, 0-0 in Round 3, and 0-0 in the final. His
best finish here is the quarter-finals, in 2019 and 2021. He did not qualify here in 2017, 2023,
2024, or 2025.

Hartford is 7 - 1 against Delco in prior events. 

Delco with the starting line advantage, but Hartford had the lead has they went by the Christmas tree
and never trailed from there on for the win.

This is the 2nd consecutive race where Matt Latino has qualified #3. Latino's overall record at this
event is 1-1. His best finish here is the quarter-finals, in 2025.

 Shane Tucker is making his 47th start.  Tucker's overall record at this event is 0-3. He did not
qualify here in 2022, and this is his first race here since that year.

This is the first time Latino and Tucker have faced each other in eliminations. 

Latino goes red to give Tucker the win.  Tucker with severe tire shake right at the hit and pushed in
the clutch and coast to the win.  this is first round win this season.

Dallas Glenn is 14 - 1 in Rd. 1 when qualified #1.  Glenn's overall record at this event is 9-3, with
a round-by-round record of 3-2 in Round 1, 2-1 in Round 2, 2-0 in Round 3, and 2-0 in the final. He
won this race in 2021, defeating Erica Enders, and in 2025, defeating Matt Hartford. He has qualified
in the top half of the field at four of his five races here, and his lowest starting position was
ninth, in 2022. His 49 final rounds are tied with D. Alderman for 11th-most in Pro Stock. Glenn is
8-3 in the Countdown this year.

Prusiensky is a no-sho to give Glenn the freebie.

Glenn launched hard and kept it hooked up to make the quickest pass of the weekend on the single.

Greg Anderson is 72 - 10 in Rd. 1 when qualified #2.  Anderson's overall record at this event is
45-18, with a round-by-round record of 18-5 in Round 1, 14-4 in Round 2, 8-6 in Round 3, and 5-3 in
the final. He won this race in 2003, defeating K. Johnson; 2004, defeating Jason Line; 2007,
defeating Jeg Coughlin; 2010, defeating Jason Line; and 2017, defeating B. Butner. He was runner-up
in 2005, losing to K. Johnson; in 2023, losing to Erica Enders; and in 2024, losing to Aaron
Stanfield.

In 2024, Anderson qualified No. 1 and set the low elapsed time of 6.591 and top speed of 207.37 here.
He has qualified in the top half of the field at 20 of his 24 races here. His lowest starting
position at this event was 11th, in 2010, and he did not qualify in 2002. He is 5-4 in the Countdown
this year.

In the last 20 years the #15 PS qualifier is 6 - 14 in Rd. 1 at this event. Vang begins the event
with an overall record of 5-12. This is his 10th race of the year.

Anderson is 2 - 0 against Vang in prior events. 

Vang broke on the starting line and Anderson is straight down the groove with his quickest pass of
the weekend for the win.  He will have lane choice over his son cody in the next round.

This is the best starting spot for Deric Kramer in his last 13 races.  
Kramer's overall record at this event is 3-11, with a round-by-round record of 3-8 in Round 1, 0-3 in
Round 2, 0-0 in Round 3, and 0-0 in the final. His best finish here is the quarter-finals, which he
reached three times. He has qualified in the top half of the field at four of his 13 races here. His
lowest starting position was 16th, in 2015, and he did not qualify here in 2013 or 2014.

Jeg Coughlin is 7 - 0 against Kramer in Rd. 1. Coughlin's overall record at this event is 34-18, with
a round-by-round record of 18-2 in Round 1 (90%), 9-9 in Round 2, 5-4 in Round 3, and 2-3 in the
final. He won this race in 2002, defeating W. Johnson, and in 2008, defeating Greg Stanfield. He was
runner-up in 2007, losing to Greg Anderson, and in 2014 and 2019, losing to Erica Enders.

Coughlin has qualified in the top half of the field at 13 of his 21 races here. His lowest starting
position was 14th, in 2016, and he did not qualify in 2001. He is 4-4 in the Countdown this year.

Coughlin is 12 - 2 against Kramer in prior events. 

Coughlin gets a couple ticks on the tree, but Kramer chased him down by half track and never trailed
from there on for the win.  Deric Kramer's MOV: 0.0071 seconds (approximately 2 feet).  He will have
lane choice over Hartford in the next round by 0.004 seconds.

Coughlin with his quickest pass of the weekend in the losing effort.
